external_cm.note: Manufacturer-published overall dimensions. Not independently measured by us. Travelpro states brand-wide: "We publish both numbers. The case dimensions (the packing body only) are 19 x 15 x 7.75 in. The overall dimensions, which include wheels and carry handles, are 21.75 x 15.75 x 7.75 in. When airlines publish size limits they mean the overall size, so compare the overall number to your airline's limit." (Travelpro FAQ, 'Do the listed dimensions include wheels and handles?'). Confirmed as the overall figure here because it exceeds this record's own packing figure.

reviews.praise: Designed to the European 55 x 40 x 20 envelope: it trades depth for width rather than maximising a US-shaped box.
reviews.caveat: Only 19.7 cm deep. Less usable space than the domestic variants, which is the trade being made.

compliance_claim.quote: Designed to meet published carry-on size restrictions for many international airlines.
